   string mOutputFile = "output/position.csv";
   bool flag = 0;
end_script_variables

script void MoverUpdated(WsfPlatform aPlatform, WsfMover aMover)
{
   FileIO myfile = FileIO();
   if(flag == 0)
   {
      flag = 1;
      myfile.Open(mOutputFile, "out");
      
      string line_flag = write_str("TIME", ",",
                     "NAME", ",",
                     "LON", ",",
                     "LAT", ",",
                     "ALT", ",",
                     "SPEED", ",",
                     "HEADING");
      myfile.Writeln(line_flag);
    #  myfile.Write("\n");            
   }
   else
   {
      myfile.Open(mOutputFile, "append");
   }

   string line = write_str(TIME_NOW, ",",
      aPlatform.Name(), ",",
      aPlatform.Longitude(), ",",
      aPlatform.Latitude(), ",",
      aPlatform.Altitude(), ",",
      aPlatform.Speed(), ",",
      aPlatform.Heading());

   myfile.Writeln(line);
  # myfile.Write("\n");
   myfile.Close();
}
end_script
